problems.description: Employees receive spear-phishing emails impersonating executives requesting urgent wire transfers or sensitive data, exploiting trust and urgency to bypass normal controls.
risk_reduction: Implement advanced email filtering with domain-based message authentication (DMARC, DKIM, SPF)
Conduct targeted phishing awareness training focusing on social engineering tactics
Require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for financial and sensitive data access

problems.description: Attackers send mass phishing emails with malicious attachments that deploy ransomware once opened, leading to widespread encryption of enterprise data.
risk_reduction: Deploy endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions to detect malicious payloads
Block executable attachments and sandbox suspicious files in email gateways
Maintain regular offline backups and test restore procedures

problems.variant: Credential harvesting via password reset scams
problems.description: Internal users receive credential harvesting links disguised as IT support notifications prompting password resets, resulting in compromised accounts.
risk_reduction: Use centralized identity providers with conditional access policies
Educate users to verify password reset requests via official channels
Monitor login anomalies and implement account lockout policies

problems.description: Cloud users receive phishing emails mimicking cloud service provider alerts, tricking them into revealing API keys or login credentials.
risk_reduction: Enable phishing-resistant MFA methods such as hardware tokens
Configure alerts and notifications to include verifiable sender information
Train users to verify URLs and avoid clicking links in unsolicited emails

problems.variant: Fake cloud management portal credential theft
problems.description: Attackers create fake cloud management portals to capture administrator credentials, enabling unauthorized access to cloud infrastructure.
risk_reduction: Enforce use of official cloud provider portals and bookmark URLs
Implement identity federation with strong authentication controls
Regularly audit cloud access logs for suspicious login attempts

problems.variant: Phishing targeting cloud developers via repo invitations
problems.description: Phishing campaigns target cloud developers with fake code repository invitations containing malicious payloads, compromising development environments.
risk_reduction: Use code repository access controls and verify invitations through secondary channels
Scan repositories and CI/CD pipelines for malicious code
Educate developers on recognizing social engineering attempts

problems.description: Individuals receive SMS or email messages impersonating banks requesting verification of account details, leading to identity theft and financial loss.
risk_reduction: Advise users to verify communications via official bank contact methods
Promote use of mobile security apps with phishing detection
Encourage enabling MFA on personal financial accounts

problems.description: Users are targeted with fake social media login pages designed to steal credentials and gain unauthorized access to personal accounts.
risk_reduction: Use password managers to detect and autofill only on legitimate sites
Enable MFA on social media accounts
Educate users on checking URLs and recognizing phishing indicators

problems.description: Phishing emails impersonate popular online retailers offering fake promotions, tricking users into submitting payment information to fraudulent sites.
risk_reduction: Verify promotions directly on official retailer websites
Use browser security extensions that warn about fraudulent sites
Avoid clicking links in unsolicited promotional emails

problems.variant: Generative AI-driven phishing and deepfake manipulation
problems.description: Attackers leverage generative AI to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing messages, deepfake audio/video calls, or chatbots to manipulate employees into disclosing sensitive information or performing unauthorized actions.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-based detection tools to identify synthetic content and anomalous communications
Enhance user training to recognize AI-generated social engineering tactics
Implement strict verification protocols for sensitive requests, including out-of-band confirmation

problems.variant: Malicious code injection in open-source libraries
problems.description: Threat actors inject malicious code into widely used open-source libraries or software dependencies, which are then propagated to enterprise environments through build pipelines, leading to widespread compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement software composition analysis (SCA) tools to monitor dependencies
Enforce strict code review and signing policies for third-party components
Continuously monitor for unusual behavior in CI/CD pipelines and production environments

problems.variant: Cloud misconfiguration leading to data exposure
problems.description: Misconfigured cloud storage buckets, databases, or services expose sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users, resulting in data breaches and compliance violations.
risk_reduction: Use automated cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools to detect misconfigurations
Enforce least privilege access and role-based access control (RBAC)
Regularly audit cloud configurations and access logs

problems.variant: Attacks on AI/ML models and training data
problems.description: Attackers manipulate input data or models to evade detection systems, poison training datasets, or cause malfunction in AI-based security controls, undermining trust in automated defenses.
risk_reduction: Implement robust model validation and anomaly detection for training data
Use adversarial training techniques to harden models
Monitor model performance and retrain regularly with verified data

problems.description: Sophisticated attackers exploit misconfigurations or vulnerabilities in Zero Trust implementations to escalate privileges or move laterally within networks without detection.
risk_reduction: Continuously validate and monitor identity and device posture
Implement micro-segmentation and strict access policies
Conduct regular penetration testing focused on Zero Trust controls
